title: Urmila Matondkar Posts Cryptic Note on Loyalty After Ex-Husband Shares Wedding Reception Photos
excerpt: The Bollywood actor's Instagram note came shortly after Mohsin Akhtar Mir shared pictures from his wedding reception with new wife Nidhaa Bhatt.
body:
• Urmila Matondkar shared a cryptic note on Instagram referencing love, loyalty and time, shortly after her ex-husband Mohsin Akhtar posted wedding reception photos
  • Mohsin married Nidhaa Bhatt in an intimate Nikah ceremony in June 2026, nearly two years after his separation from Urmila
  • Urmila and Mohsin were married in February 2016 in an interfaith ceremony; Urmila filed for divorce in September 2024

Bollywood actor Urmila Matondkar shared a cryptic note on Instagram about loyalty, with the post widely interpreted as a response to her ex-husband Mohsin Akhtar Mir's recent social media posts from his wedding reception with new wife Nidhaa Bhatt.

"I like love, loyalty and time," Urmila's note read, according to multiple Indian media reports, without directly naming anyone or referencing her former marriage.

Mohsin's New Chapter

Mohsin Akhtar Mir, a model and businessman from Kashmir, married Nidhaa Bhatt in an intimate traditional Nikah ceremony in June 2026. He recently shared a series of photographs from the wedding reception on Instagram, accompanied by an emotional caption reflecting on his personal journey.

https://x.com/dna/status/2087389862798426444

"Pure intentions, honest love, and a heart full of sabr and shukur. Keep your soul pure, heal along the way, and trust that Allah's script is always better. In His perfect time, my gorgeous wifey, he rewarded me with your sincerity and blessed me. You brought light in my life."

— Mohsin Akhtar Mir, in his Instagram post

Mohsin also paid tribute to his late mother in the same post, writing: "And thank you, Mouji, for looking after me from the other side of the world. I know it's your blessing and your love for me that came like this."

For the ceremony, the couple opted for an elegant traditional aesthetic. Mohsin wore a cream-white sherwani with floral embroidery, while Nidhaa Bhatt chose an off-white sharara set with golden zari and sequin embellishments.

A Marriage That Attracted Attention

Urmila and Mohsin married on February 4, 2016, in an intimate ceremony attended by close friends and family, with designer Manish Malhotra being the only prominent Bollywood personality in attendance. Their union attracted considerable attention at the time — it was an interfaith marriage with a nearly 10-year age difference between them. Urmila was 42 and Mohsin was 32 at the time of their wedding.

Reports of trouble in the marriage first surfaced in 2024, with subsequent reports claiming that Urmila filed for divorce in a Mumbai court in September of that year. Neither party has spoken extensively about the circumstances of their separation.

Urmila's Career and Public Life

Urmila Matondkar, known for iconic roles in films like Rangeela, Satya and Kaun, has maintained a relatively low public profile in recent years. She briefly entered politics, contesting the 2019 Lok Sabha elections from Mumbai North on a Congress ticket. While she lost that election, she continues to be a respected figure in Indian cinema.

The timing of her cryptic post — coinciding with Mohsin's public celebration of his new marriage — has fuelled speculation in the entertainment press. However, neither Urmila nor her representatives have issued any statement confirming the note was directed at her former husband.
